name: Nullfield - A Theremin Simulator
summary:
Nullfield is a theremin you can play in VR: the electronic instrument you play without touching it. Your right hand sets the pitch near the antenna, your left hand shapes the volume above the loop. No scores, no timers. It is an instrument, and you get better by playing.

REALISTIC SOUND
• Real-time synthesis: every note is generated live, no samples
• A true theremin field with zero-beat tuning, aerial fingering, vibrato and a gentle tube drift
• 10 voice presets, plus piano, guitar, harp, organ, flute and
